claim: In the hydrodynamic limit of the scaled Boltzmann equation for gas mixtures, the linearized Boltzmann operator L̂ is self-adjoint in L²_v and satisfies ½L̂(g²)=Γ̂(g,g) for any g in Ker L̂.
falsifier: One can verify these properties for the linearized Boltzmann operator under the same assumptions.

conditions: The operator is defined on L²_v with respect to the global Maxwellian
exclusions: Limited to the linearized Boltzmann operator with cut-off hard potentials
Limited to the specific form of the collision kernel used in the paper

title: Linearized Boltzmann operator–Self-adjointness and the relation theorem
